file_sha256: SHA256 of exact file bytes, including indentation and final newline

review_digest.encoding: UTF-8 json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False); default separators: comma-space and colon-space

policy_digest.encoding: Same service record encoding as review_digest

program_schema_preview_digest.encoding: Same service record encoding as review_digest

profile_digest.encoding: UTF-8 json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)

approval_state: No digest in this draft is a signed owner approval or an execution authorization.
